    iterators = [iter(it) for it in iterables]
    
    while True:
        items = []
        exhausted = False
        for i, it in enumerate(iterators):
            item = next(it, sentinel)
            if item is sentinel:
                if not exhausted:
                    exhausted = True
                    first_exhausted_index = i
                elif i != first_exhausted_index:
                    # One iterable was already exhausted, and this one too
                    raise UnequalIterablesError(...)
            else:
                if exhausted:
                    raise UnequalIterablesError(...)
                items.append(item)
        
        if exhausted:
            break
        
        yield tuple(items)
